## Copilot routing

- Follow `AGENTS.md` as the canonical instruction file for this repo.
- Do not preload `TODO.md`, `CURRENT_FEATURE.md`, or other large docs unless the prompt is clearly about ongoing feature work
  or the current task needs repo-specific reference material.
- When docs are needed, start with `internaldocs/README.md` and then open only the most relevant file(s).
